newsitem.title: USA: Anicom buys Security Supply for $2.0 mln.
newsitem.headline: Anicom buys Security Supply for $2.0 mln.

text.p: Anicom Inc said Monday it purchased New Orleans-based Security Supply Inc, which specializes in the sale and distribution of alarm, security and life safety products, for about $2.0 million in cash and stock.
Security Supply had total revenues of about $3.6 million in fiscal 1996. Anicom said this deal brings to nine the number of acquisitions it has made since July 1995.

"This acquisition will further expand Anicom's position in the burgeoning alarm and security market," Scott Anixter, chief executive officer, said in a statement. "Security Supply will enhance our customer base, add to our geographical market presence and expand the breadth and depth of our products."
Anicom said it also sold its Northern Connectivity Systems, a value-added cable assembly manufacturer, for undisclosed terms. Anicom said it retains exclusive distribution rights.
No further details were immediately available.

Anicom also announced the opening of four new sales offices, including its first site outside the United States, in the Netherlands. The others are in Tuscon, Ariz., Baton Rouge, La., and Wausau, Wis.
Anicom now has more than 40 locations nationwide.
"We intend to open other targeted locations as opportunities develop," Carl Putnam, president, said in a statement.
